arStrings.szText:
{c_label}Cooldown:{/c} {c_resource}{Cooldown Time}{/c} seconds
{if:ADVANCED_TOOLTIP}{c_label}Lucky Hit Chance: {/c}{c_resource}[{Combat_Effect_Chance_Script_Formula_Override:16}|1%|]{/c}
{/if}Conjure blades of ice for {c_number}[{SF_0}|1|]{/c} seconds that rapidly slash enemies, dealing {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_DAMAGE}{/c} damage and making them {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c}.

You may have up to {c_number}[SF_21]{/c} {c_important}Ice Blades{/c} active at a time.
{c_important}Ice Blades's{/c} Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_9}|1|]{/c} seconds each time it hits a {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} enemy.
Every {c_number}{SF_24}rd{/c} slash from {c_important}Ice Blades{/c} is an Ice Crack, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEA_DAMAGE}{/c} damage in a large cone.

{c_important}Ice Blades{/c} is now cast at the target location and surrounds it with {c_number}[SF_30]{/c} {c_important}Ice Blades{/c}.

{c_important}Ice Blades{/c} {c_important}{u}Chill{/u}{/c} enemies for {c_number}[SF_31|%|]{/c}, but their Movement Speed is reduced by {c_number}[SF_32 * 100|%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Ice Blades{/c} becomes a {c_important}Pyromancy{/c} Skill that deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_DAMAGE}{/c} Fire damage.

{c_important}Ice Blades{/c} gain {c_number}[SF_34 * 100|%|]{/c} Cast Speed, but drain {c_number}[SF_39]{/c} Mana per attack.
{c_important}Ice Blades'{/c} Cooldown is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_9}|1|]{/c} seconds each time it attacks an enemy.
{c_important}Ice Blades{/c} gains {c_number}[{SF_35} * 100|%+|]{/c} Cast Speed when attacking {c_important}{u}Frozen{/u}{/c} enemies.
{c_important}Ice Blades'{/c} duration is increased by {c_number}[SF_37]{/c} seconds.
